To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) employees` assumptions are the third cognitive level of organizational cultural according to the Scheins theory and they can be measured by using questionnaire and EFA; 2) employees` assumptions about innovation process are mostly positive, but there is a fear of failure; 3) employees' assumptions about innovation process can be used as an indicator of organizational culture and as a tool for innovation process improvement.

(a) employees in Serbian companies have positive attitude towards innovations; (b) they have positive attitude towards the idea of introducing innovations; (c) they have positive attitudes towards the idea of innovation management in their companies; (d) they do not have positive attitude towards innovation introducing in their companies; and (e) they do not know the rules, tools and discipline of innovation introducing.

(1) questionnaire could be useful tool for collecting employees assumptions, (2) employees in Serbian companies have positive attitude toward innovations, (3) innovation process have to include specific rules, tools and discipline in order to reduce employees fear and increase their motivation.
